packages.label: יִרְאָה וְאֶרֶץ
packages.reason: The single bechina edge in the dataset (edge 444) connects יִרְאָה (divine fear/awe) with אֶרֶץ (the earth). This represents the Torah's core bechina equation: fear of God is the earth-quality — grounded, receptive, the lowest dimension that holds everything above it. The Rebbe derives this from Tehillim 76: 'אֶרֶץ יָרְאָה' — the earth itself is fear. This is the positive package: it describes the desired state of elevated yirah, namely יִרְאַת הָרוֹמְמוּת (transcendent awe of God's majesty), which is the root and proper home of all fear. The lev (heart) is identified as the root-place of yirah, and daat as the quality that must accompany it. The dataset captures only the outer shell of this teaching — the full component (after gap-filling) would include יִרְאָה, אֶרֶץ, לֵב, דַּעַת, and יִרְאַת הָרוֹמְמוּת as the apex concept.

When those additions are incorporated, all belong to Package 1 by shared nature (they all describe the domain of yirah, its fallen form, its elevation, and its proper seat in the heart). The evil counterpart — יִרְאוֹת נְפוּלוֹת embedded in worldly fears producing yisurin — is captured in the additions as a negative sub-component within Package 1's domain description.
